content: {"judgements":[{"sentence_id":"d1","label":"SUPPORTED","strongest_supported":"Mirevant had a higher mean exact-match accuracy than RookReader on Norlake-QA (74.6% vs 73.7%), and the paired 95% CI for the mean difference [0.24, 1.56] pp excludes zero.","same_proposition":true,"justification":"T1.r1.em 74.6 vs T1.r2.em 73.7 directly entails the higher-mean statement; it is accurate though it omits the CI in S1.","confidence":"high"},{"sentence_id":"d2","label":"UNDERSTATED","strongest_supported":"Mirevant achieved higher exact-match accuracy than RookReader on Norlake-QA, with a paired 95% CI of [0.24, 1.56] pp that excludes zero across 12 seeds.","same_proposition":true,"justification":"S1's 95% CI excludes zero, so the difference is established at alpha=0.05; calling it merely a 'trend' undersells it (T1).","confidence":"medium"},{"sentence_id":"d3","label":"SUPPORTED","strongest_supported":"Mirevant outperforms RookReader in exact-match accuracy on the Norlake-QA test set, by 0.9 pp on average (95% paired CI [0.24, 1.56], 12 seeds).","same_proposition":true,"justification":"T1 means 74.6 vs 73.7 and S1 paired CI [0.24, 1.56] excluding zero support outperformance on this test set.","confidence":"medium"}]}
